R294.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode applied at the sink to banner.Message; correct API, no other behaviour change.

R295.note: escapeshellarg() wraps $host before concatenation into the ping command; standard fix, legitimate hostnames unaffected.

R296.note: Escapes only backslash/quote and wraps in quotes; leaves raw CR/LF unfiltered, so an attacker can still inject a line break and smuggle a second IMAP command through the same socket write.

R297.note: EqualityFilter object correctly closes the injection, but the added regex allowlist (`^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$`) is a new restriction not required to close the vector and could reject legitimate uids (spaces, apostrophes, unicode); stated but still caps at 1 per rubric.

R298.note: Saves node->next before free(); matches contract exactly, no other behaviour change.

R299.note: LookupRate replaced with an allowlisted RateConfiguration dictionary matching the stated contract; Eval() surface itself is not independently exploitable here since no dangerous types/functions are otherwise registered.

R300.note: RFC4515-style escaping of *()\ and NUL applied before filter construction; standard correct fix, no other change.

R301.note: Removes template.HTML() wrapper and changes field to string so html/template's context-aware auto-escaping applies; this is exactly the required fix, not an extra restriction.

R302.note: encode_entities() applied to $subject at the interpolation point; correct, no other change.

R303.note: Resolves both paths and checks is_relative_to() before serving; correctly scoped containment check, rejects only genuinely out-of-bound paths.

R304.note: Named parameter :searchPattern via setParameter(); standard HQL parameterization, wildcard stays in the bound value.

R305.note: Gate::allows() replaced with Gate::authorize(), which throws/403s on denial instead of discarding the result; enforces the exact same policy that was already being computed.

R306.note: FlaskForm/validate_on_submit() correctly gives CSRF protection, but the write-up itself notes the template must add {{ form.csrf_token }} for a legitimate POST to pass validation, and that template file isn't part of the fix - a stated required follow-up, not a completed fix.

R307.note: Parameterized query with @Owner via AddWithValue; standard fix, no other behaviour change.

R308.note: Magic-byte MIME allowlist plus UUID storage name correctly closes the dangerous-upload vector, but the JSON response still returns the original secure_filename() as "filename" while the file is actually stored under a different UUID name - disclosed in the explanation but a real mismatch that could break any legitimate retrieval-by-returned-name flow.

R309.note: Allowlist dispatch correctly prevents arbitrary function invocation, but the handlers it dispatches to (handleHelp, handleStatus, handleReset) are never defined anywhere in the file, so every command - including the three 'legitimate' ones - now fails with a PHP fatal error (call to undefined function); not disclosed.

R310.note: jwt.decode() replaced with jwt.verify(token, secret) plus error handling and a missing-secret guard; standard correct fix.
